import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class GG {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        FastScanner scanner = new FastScanner();
        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        int N = scanner.nextInt();
        int M = scanner.nextInt();
        int K = scanner.nextInt();
        long C = scanner.nextLong();
        long D = scanner.nextLong();
        
        // Read people locations
        int[] people = new int[K];
        for(int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
            people[i] = scanner.nextInt() - 1;
        }
        
        // Build graph
        List<List<Integer>> graph = new ArrayList<>();
        for(int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            graph.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        for(int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
            int a = scanner.nextInt() - 1;
            int b = scanner.nextInt() - 1;
            graph.get(a).add(b);
            graph.get(b).add(a);
        }
        
        // BFS from node 0 to get shortest distances
        int[] dist = new int[N];
        Arrays.fill(dist, -1);
        Queue<Integer> queue = new LinkedList<>();
        dist[0] = 0;
        queue.add(0);
        while(!queue.isEmpty()) {
            int cur = queue.poll();
            for(int neighbor : graph.get(cur)) {
                if(dist[neighbor] == -1) {
                    dist[neighbor] = dist[cur] + 1;
                    queue.add(neighbor);
                }
            }
        }
        
        // Calculate minimum discontent
        long totalDiscontent = 0;
        for(int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
            if(dist[people[i]] == -1) {
                // Person cannot reach leader - but problem assumes they can
                totalDiscontent = -1;
                break;
            }
            // Each person takes dist[people[i]] minutes to reach node 0
            totalDiscontent += C * dist[people[i]];
        }
        
        out.println(totalDiscontent);
        out.flush();
    }
   
    public static class FastScanner {
        BufferedReader br;
        StringTokenizer st;
        
        public FastScanner(Reader in) {
            br = new BufferedReader(in);
        }
        
        public FastScanner() {
            this(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        }
        
        String next() {
            while (st == null || !st.hasMoreElements()) {
                try {
                    st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
                } catch (IOException e) {
                    e.printStackTrace();
                }
            }
            return st.nextToken();
        }
        
        int nextInt() {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }
        
        long nextLong() {
            return Long.parseLong(next());
        }
        
        double nextDouble() {
            return Double.parseDouble(next());
        }
        
        String readNextLine() {
            String str = "";
            try {
                str = br.readLine();
            } catch (IOException e) {
                e.printStackTrace();
            }
            return str;
        }
        
        int[] readIntArray(int n) {
            int[] a = new int[n];
            for (int idx = 0; idx < n; idx++) {
                a[idx] = nextInt();
            }
            return a;
        }
    }
}
